name: Expedia Group Partner API
tagline: Hotel, package, and lodging distribution APIs for Expedia Group partners
description: Expedia Group Partner API provides B2B access to hotel, package, and lodging inventory through the official partner developer portal at developers.expediagroup.com. Partners integrate search, availability, booking, and content for Expedia's global lodging network after commercial onboarding; authentication and endpoints are partner-program specific rather than fully public self-serve.

auth.details: Partner credentials via API key and shared secret (EPS Rapid) or OAuth depending on product; commercial partner agreement required, not fully self-serve public keys.

pricing.paid_plans: Commercial partner contracts; pricing not publicly listed on developer portal

example.request: ts=$(date +%s); sig=$(printf '%s' "${API_KEY}${SHARED_SECRET}${ts}" | openssl dgst -sha512 -hex | awk '{print $2}'); curl -sS --compressed "https://api.ean.com/v3/properties/content?language=en-US&supply_source=expedia&property_id=1337&include=name" -H "Accept: application/json" -H "Authorization: EAN APIKey=${API_KEY},Signature=${sig},timestamp=${ts}"

use_cases: search hotel availability by destination and dates
get property content and amenities for a hotel ID
check room rates and packages for lodging
book or hold a hotel reservation as a partner
retrieve booking confirmation and itinerary details
